auditor_compatibility_fix.reason: Native OpenPI reads microbatch_size; custom adapters read worker_microbatch_size. Audit now follows the selected engine and rejects misleading unused aliases. Training runtime unchanged.

preserved_diagnostic_attempts.reason: Controlled stop after 55 healthy updates: official instance API omitted device count, so the initial API-only allocation gate correctly withheld loading. Replaced by official-instance plus independently read assigned-device-mask proof.

Failed during initial model loading before any COMMIT: shared HF Arrow cache was read before generation completed. Per-platform-job dataset cache isolation and run-owned OpenPI source rebasing were then added.

limits: This stage validates bounded short-run dynamic exact16 admission, not a new 2000-step/20000-step stability run or LIBERO task quality.

Native admission uses a full shared-storage checkpoint; its 321.59-second boundary pause remains an optimization target. Healthy training continues during cold loading, but pauses for final complete-state alignment.
Per-step HCCL SUM and per-device native Adam remain the existing backend; steady timing is not a comparison against a simultaneously measured packed cluster baseline.
Candidate failure/init rollback cases are covered by protocol tests; this hardware acceptance injects failures into already-active pods.
A fully occupied64-card budget has no room for an additional16-card replacement batch. All pending and unknown requests count against the budget.

The independent numerical gradient/Adam reference applies to toy runs. Native OpenPI audit checks finite recorded values, protocol evidence and checkpoint bytes, not independent OpenPI gradient recomputation.
